뜻하다.e: to mean; to indicate; to stand for
뜻하다.n: native Korean verb for meaning — signs, symbols, spoken and written
cf: to mean; to signify; to imply
Sino-Korean verb for meaning — more formal, explanations and writing

붓다.n: general word for pouring liquid into something
cf: pouring forcefully or in large amounts, all at once

붓다.n: body part swelling from injury or illness
cf: to waver; to wave; to undulate
soft, slow, wavy movement of cloth, flags, or waves; graceful
to swell; to roll; to heave
sea rolling in big swells, esp. before a storm

훗날.n: Word for some future day, with a wistful, literary tone
cf: that day: a day already mentioned, usually past
written style, points back to a day just named
the day before a specific day, not simply yesterday
Sino-Korean word for a later day; more written and neutral, used in documents and narration.

방랑벽.n: an urge to wander and travel, a personal trait
cf: someone with no settled home moving place to place; can sound pitying or looked-down-on
spoken, slightly negative — one-time visitors, not regulars
literary — a person roaming the world, a bit romantic
